# COUNTRY scope. The Sultan answers the Petition of the Sheikhs (weighted by the Dual Power).
NSR_petition_answer = {
	random_list = {
		30 = {	# he concedes
			modifier = { factor = 2 power_balance_value = { id = NSR_dual_power_bop value > 0.3 } }
			modifier = { factor = 0.3 power_balance_value = { id = NSR_dual_power_bop value < -0.2 } }
			country_event = { id = nsr.240 days = 7 }
		}
		30 = {	# he refuses
			modifier = { factor = 2 power_balance_value = { id = NSR_dual_power_bop value < -0.2 } }
			modifier = { factor = 0.5 power_balance_value = { id = NSR_dual_power_bop value > 0.3 } }
			country_event = { id = nsr.241 days = 7 }
		}
		40 = {	# he stalls
			country_event = { id = nsr.242 days = 7 }
		}
	}
}
